Alia

Overview

Alia is Feiruz’s fiancée and a contact of the Last Shelter. After escaping prison and losing him, she leads Kir and Kel to the brotherhood and vouches for them before Brother Khatul. She also asks them to find the missing Sahilia and obtain medicine for her recovery. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Feiruz’s last rescue

Feiruz asks Kir to repay his help by rescuing his imprisoned fiancée Alia. He dies during the escape. Kel urges the grieving Aliya to avenge him and identifies the man who struck the fatal blow. Kir objects to deliberate revenge, but their companions insist on their code. The death of the prison commandant brings searches across the city. Fearing for his collection, Rindeil withdraws his protection, though he says Kir may return once the danger passes. Aliya then leads Kir and Kel to the Last Shelter and speaks for them before Brother Khatul. [6, 1, 7, 2, 3]

The ring and the brotherhood

Khatul demands an imperial signet ring from a cyclops as a test of trust. Kir brings it back and explains his intention to free his family. He also recognises that the ring does not match the description he has read. Khatul already knows it is false, but asks him to preserve the brotherhood’s belief in the trophy. Membership changes how Brother Blacksmith receives Kir: the smith who refused a stranger now offers his craft. Through Aliya, Kir also searches for the missing Sahilia, rescues her and brings medicine. Sahilia’s recovery matters later, when her forged papers open a route into the army. [8, 9, 10, 11, 4, 5, 12, 13]
